name: Codecov
description: GitHub Action that uploads coverage reports for your repository to codecov.io

token.description: Repository Codecov token. Used to authorize report uploads

codecov_yml_path.description: Specify the path to the Codecov YML

commit_parent.description: Override to specify the parent commit SHA

directory.description: Directory to search for coverage reports.

disable_file_fixes.description: Disable file fixes to ignore common lines from coverage (e.g. blank lines or empty brackets)

disable_search.description: Disable search for coverage files. This is helpful when specifying what files you want to upload with the --file option.

disable_safe_directory.description: Disable setting safe directory. Set to true to disable.

env_vars.description: Environment variables to tag the upload with (e.g. PYTHON | OS,PYTHON)

fail_ci_if_error.description: Specify whether or not CI build should fail if Codecov runs into an error during upload

file.description: Path to coverage file to upload

files.description: Comma-separated list of files to upload

flags.description: Flag upload to group coverage metrics (e.g. unittests | integration | ui,chrome)

handle_no_reports_found.description: Raise no exceptions when no coverage reports found

name.description: User defined upload name. Visible in Codecov UI

network_filter.description: Specify a filter on the files listed in the network section of the Codecov report. This will only add files whose path begin with the specified filter. Useful f

network_prefix.description: Specify a prefix on files listed in the network section of the Codecov report. Useful to help resolve path fixing

os.description: Override the assumed OS. Options are linux | macos | windows.

override_build_url.description: The URL of the build where this is running

plugin.description: plugins to run. Options: xcode, gcov, pycoverage. The default behavior runs them all.

plugins.description: Comma-separated list of plugins for use during upload.

report_code.description: The code of the report. If unsure, do not include

root_dir.description: Used when not in git/hg project to identify project root directory

url.description: Specify the base url to upload (Enterprise use)

use_oidc.description: Use OIDC instead of token. This will ignore any token supplied

verbose.description: Specify whether the Codecov output should be verbose

version.description: Specify which version of the Codecov CLI should be used. Defaults to `latest`

working-directory.description: Directory in which to execute codecov.sh
